baseline.name: Nonmutating run sum minus run maximum
baseline.approach: For every same-color run, add its total cost minus its largest cost.

why: Both keep the most expensive balloon in each run and remove the others. The archived propagation uses writes into the cost array rather than only local run totals.
quantitative_comparison: Both examine n-1 adjacency relationships with linear work. The archive additionally mutates some cost entries; no asymptotic storage or measured timing advantage over the nonmutating baseline is established.
tradeoffs: The input cost array is changed. A nonmutating run-based method retains the same complexity while preserving callers' data.
evidence_basis: Static comparison of equivalent run-cost invariants; no paired timing.
